name: Ride-On Lawnmower Trailer
comingSoonLabel: I am on my way! Just not ready yet.
description: The ultimate in versatility around the lifestyle block. Designed to haul big loads on the back of your Ride-On so you don't have to drive your vehicle into a paddock or large block.

name: Trailer Axle Replacement
description: Axle-lotta damage? A Woman With a Welder will whip the old off and replace with the new quick as. This price is for axles supplied by customers, but I can handle the re-build if you let me know what you need.

name: Book a Welding Service
description: Need something glued together? Gotcha! Find an available day to book my welding services and I'll get in touch with you as soon as possible about what you are wanting to get done. It's even easier on Facebook too.

name: Free No-Obligation Quote
description: Having issues wit your trailer? Not sure what you are looking at and need a second opinion? Stop in and see A Woman With a Welder for a free no-obligation quote by booking a time and date available.

name: Electrical Diagnosis & Repairs
description: Having electrical issues with your trailer? Not sure why one indicator is working and the other isn't? Probably best to book A Woman With a Welder today and you can book an available date today.

variants.name: Complete Trailer Service (Single Axle) - Caged Trailer

name: Wheel Bearing Replacement (Single Axle)
description:
Wheel Bearing Replacements for your trailer of any make or model, domestic or imported.
Rest easy knowing you'll know the numbers before you get the bill.

name: Coffee Tables
title: Coffee Tables
description: Keen a new coffee cup stand? A Woman With a Welder makes a pretty flash coffee table and you can even decide the style and size you want it to be.

name: Aluminium Planter Boxes
title: Aluminium Planter Boxes
description: Planning on planting some plants? Why not get a custom coloured aluminium planter box - lightweight but heavy-duty and extremely long lasting. The good thing is you get to customize the size and the colour!

name: Trailer Axle Builder
title: Trailer Axle Builder
description: Need a specifically sized Axle for your trailer? Resolve a true price using the configurations below and A Woman With a Welder will build you the axle you desire.

optionGroups.name: Wheel Size
optionGroups.description: Choose the size of the wheel you are intending on using so the configurator can offer the accurate solutions.

options.description: Choose this option if the axle you want needs to fit into 40mm U-Bolts.
